newsitem.title: GERMANY: Springer to raise SAT1 stake to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Springer to raise SAT1 stake to 40 pct.

text.p: Publisher Axel Springer Verlag AG said on Thursday it planned to raise its holdings, both indirect and direct, in Germany's SAT1 television channel to 40 percent, pending approval by regulators.

Springer said in a statement that it had received offers from other shareholders in Aktuell Presse-Fernsehen GmbH -- which owns 20 percent of SAT1 -- to sell their shares. It now owns 41 percent of Aktuell.
Through those offers Springer would "directly and indirectly have disposal over 40 percent of the shares in SAT1," the statement said.
Springer added that preliminary inquiries at the German cartel office in October had raised no objections.
